name: CLAY Multi-Model Review (synthetic contract example)
purpose: Coordinate optional bounded model roles for independent analysis and criticism while retaining unresolved differences and evidence dependencies.

capabilities.description: Review outputs against shared criteria and search for material omissions or counterexamples.

out_of_scope: Treating model majority as calibrated truth
Granting permissions or authorizing external execution
Claiming independent confirmation when models share sources or assumptions

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: A bounded question suitable for independent analysis.

inputs.name: evidence
inputs.description: The minimal evidence set and known provenance.

outputs.name: model_findings
outputs.description: Separately attributed model outputs with relevant dependencies.

outputs.name: disagreements
outputs.description: Unresolved disagreements and evidence needed to evaluate them.

outputs.name: synthesis
outputs.description: A bounded synthesis that does not use vote count as truth.

verification_requirements: Record common sources and shared assumptions where known.
Do not use vote count as confidence.
Preserve disagreement and independently verify material factual claims.
notes: Synthetic example only; no providers, credentials, models, or orchestration runtime are connected.
